description: Validates discussion feedback is captured as structured, append-only FeedbackItems and routed into change-management without manual re-transcription

checks.description: A feedback log should exist once at least one discussion session has occurred
checks.remediation: Run screen-discussfeedback during a mockup review session; this check is soft since a project may not yet have had a discussion session

checks.description: Every feedback entry must reference a specific screen
checks.remediation: Every FeedbackItem must carry a screen_ref (SCR-[###]) per R-612's structured capture requirement

checks.description: Every feedback entry must declare whether it came from a real stakeholder or role-play
checks.remediation: Declare source_mode per R-614; role-played entries must additionally document the role lens and assumption used

checks.description: This skill must never author artifacts/Changes/ files directly — only change-management may generate them
checks.remediation: screen-discussfeedback hands off feedback_text to change-management; it must not generate change documents itself

checks.description: Routed feedback items should have their change-management link recorded
checks.remediation: Once change-management returns a change_id for a feedback item, update its 'Routed To' field — soft since a feedback item may be captured but not yet routed
